entries.subject: Color
entries.finding: The planet's flux densities in JWST/NIRCam F460M, F430M and F410M, 139.4, 159.7 and 238.2 µJy (Balmer et al. 2025, Table 2), drive red, green and blue. The result, #9ea8c8, is infrared false color, not what an eye would see, and one color for the whole disc.

entries.subject: Limb darkening
entries.finding: The disc is dimmed toward the limb by the quadratic law fitted to the JWST/NIRCam F430M intensity PICASO 4.1 (Batalha et al. 2019, ApJ 878, 70) computes from Sonora Diamondback cloudy (Morley et al. 2024, ApJ 975, 59; [M/H] +0.5, f_sed 2) model atmospheres at 1,200 K and log g 3.5, read between the models t1100g31f2_m+0.5_co1.0, t1100g100f2_m+0.5_co1.0, t1200g31f2_m+0.5_co1.0, t1200g100f2_m+0.5_co1.0 (u1 0.337, u2 0.291; the law fits each model's eight angles within 0.31% of the centre): a cloudy model, the one Nasedkin et al. (2024), A&A 687, A298 fit to this planet, because no table reaches a planet this cold and nobody has resolved its disc. The temperature and gravity are that fit's (Table 9 (grid-fit chi-squared results), HR 8799 c, Diamondback: chi-squared 3900, Teff 1200, log g 3.5, [M/H] 0.5, f_sed 2.0, C/O 0.458, radius 1.08; the single best-fit model of that grid; [record](source/photometry/atmosphere-fit.json)), not the 1,159 K of its measurements record.
